messages:
alex_m: Heads-up: we're running a short social push around the Apr 12 webinar 'Inference Economics'. Need X thread, LinkedIn long post, and two short follow-ups. Primary conversion: webinar signup -> SDR routing. Can we get drafts + assets by EOB tomorrow?

sara_ops: Confirm CTA = webinar signup. We should also include a post-webinar report download CTA. Timezone: PT.

jordan_g: Routing: signups with corporate email -> SFDC queue 'Bench-Webinar'. Others into nurture. Use utm_campaign=bench-apr12. I'll send field mapping this afternoon.

priya_content: I'll draft: 6-card X thread, LinkedIn long-form (3 short paras), and two reminder posts. Need one hero stat + 3 soundbites. Miguel, can you make a hero image + 2 carousel frames?

miguel_design: Yup. Uploading hero_stat.png and carousel_A/B by 10:00 tomorrow. Exports for X and LinkedIn sizes included.

sara_ops: Scheduler-bot: propose publish slots so I can load into Buffer. Also, do we tag partners day-of?

scheduler-bot: Proposed slots: 2024-04-12T09:30:00-07:00, 2024-04-12T11:45:00-07:00, 2024-04-13T10:00:00-07:00. Reply with "lock <slot_ids>" to reserve.

priya_content: Draft X thread below (quick). Feedback on tone and CTA placement please.

priya_content: ```
1/ We benchmarked inference latency & per-token cost across open models and setups. The headline surprised us.
2/ Short take: serving decisions often change unit economics more than model choice.
3/ Stat: 2x cost gap at the 95th percentile under small-batch traffic.
4/ Join our Apr 12 webinar for full benchmarks + playbooks: https://redwood.ai/bench?utm_campaign=bench-apr12&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social
5/ Bonus: live demo + Q&A. Full report sent post-webinar.
6/ RSVP now — seats limited.
```

alex_m: Good. Put the hero stat in the first card and shorten line 4 for scannability. Keep CTAs consistent across channels.

miguel_design: Assets uploaded: hero_stat_v3.png (1200x675), carousel_A.png, carousel_B.png. Link: <asset-link>. Alt: 'Latency vs cost across models and regions'.

sara_ops: Posting CSV draft: 
post_time,platform,copy,asset,utm_campaign,utm_source,sd_queue
2024-04-12T09:30:00-07:00,x,"Thread start: hero stat + signup",hero_stat_v3.png,bench-apr12,x,Bench-Webinar
2024-04-12T11:45:00-07:00,linkedin,"Long post: 3 para + signup",carousel_A.png,bench-apr12,linkedin,Nurture
2024-04-13T10:00:00-07:00,x,"Post + report CTA",carousel_B.png,bench-apr12,x,Bench-Webinar

jordan_g: Approve UTMs. Also add utm_content=boost-testA to the 11:45 LinkedIn post if we run a small paid test. I'll finalize SFDC campaign mapping by EOD.

sara_ops: Lock plan if everyone OK. I'll push to Buffer after final copy and assets.

scheduler-bot: Slot IDs: 101, 102, 103. Reply with "lock 101,102,103" to reserve.

alex_m: lock 101,102,103

sara_ops: Thanks. Priya -> please attach final copy in the doc by 5pm tomorrow. Jordan -> confirm SFDC fields tonight. Miguel -> confirm asset variants.

priya_content: Will upload final drafts and shortlines for each post by 5pm. Ping if you want tone edits.

alex_m: Awesome. Tag partners day-of as discussed. Thanks team. :rocket:
